eps.d: Marcus throws his pregnant lover out, is confronted by a TV crew and meets a homeless runaway called Pilar.
Stanley and Rosemary arrive at their new villa but their furniture is nowhere to be seen. Trish plays a gig while Dieter drinks her earnings.
Stanley and Rosemary settle in to life in Los Barcos, meanwhile Fizz struggles to adjust to life in Spain with her new husband.
Drew tries to get Blair to mend his ways. Bunny is jealous of Fizz's admirers. Dieter thinks it's time Miss King was taught a lesson.
Bunny investigates Fizz's secret admirer. Fizz opens up to Joy about her life on the streets before she met Bunny.
Saturday night in Los Barcos. Marcus makes a move on Pilar. Freddie gets stood up. Isabelle takes Per on a trip to the Fiesta.
It's Bunny and Fizz's day of reckoning and Stanley's in a mood, but it's Olive who makes a nasty discovery.
Marcus appears on television and Freddie strays into terrible danger. Trish wows the tourists in Joy's Bar, much to Dieter's annoyance.
How long can Pilar hold out against Marcus's charm?
Can the Hindle boys pay for a trip home after receiving bad news?
Nessa objects to the sponsored walk set up by her mother.
Fizz settles into her new job at the supermarket; the sponsored walk is hard work for Bunny and makes Nessa feel discriminated against.
Drew takes against the tourists and Rosemary and Stanley start to wander. Pilar's life is changing - for the better?
Pilar is not popular with the Spanish and Drew gives Gwen cause for concern.
Pilar moves in with Marcus and sees his darker side, Fizz catches Blair shop lifting, and Olive wants to replace Gwen as residents' association president.
A disturbed night ends in a home-coming. Trine and Arnaud try to get together. Drew panics when he sees Marcus's associates.
Kitty decides to return to England; Rosemary feels let down by her family on her birthday; Trine and Arnaud can't find a quiet spot.
Bunny is concerned about the attention Fizz is receiving from other men and his standing guard forces her to take drastic action.
Trish slams a door, Marcus makes Drew resort to bad habits and Bunny offers Fizz a job.
Gavin's odd behaviour worries Allan. Fizz starts a new job, under Bunny's ever watchful eye, and there is a disappearance at the Lockheads.
It's Election day in Los Barcos and Olive is on the campaign trail. Per spies on Trine and Arnaud. Freddie gets a present.
Gwen has a showdown with Marcus over his blackmail threats while Pilar gives him a wide berth. Dieter is sulking and Trish is frustrated.
Gwen confronts Marcus about blackmail. Will Fizz get over her big shock?
A crafty plan is devised to get Trine and Arnaud together, and Blair looks for a source of income.
Gavin and Allan are on the pull (oh dear) while Snowy makes a splash. Fizz asserts her independence.
Blair turns over a new leaf. Pilar loses her job and feels the pressure of being a Spanish girl with an English man.
Maria is embarrassed by her crush on Philippe. Dieter has a new girlfriend. Fizz opens up to Bunny about her past.
Rosemary prepares for her audition. Maria confides in Ingrid. Fizz takes a riding lesson with Pilar. Gwen is afraid that Blair is the prowler.
Suspicions abound in Los Barcos. Marcus confronts Antonio about his visit to Las Terrazas.
Marcus tries to persuade Pilar to go on holiday with him, but she refuses to take time off from work.
Rosemary waits for news, Blair starts to date, and Bunny makes a terrible mistake.
Can Bunny and Fizz save their marriage?
Drew worries about Nessa's future. Dieter has a new girlfriend but can't quite forget Trish.
Pilar makes a disturbing discovery about Marcus. Olive becomes a saleswoman - and an unwitting matchmaker.
Trish receives a gift from an unexpected source.
Olive is horrified by some surprise visitors to the church service. Blair takes Maria on another date.
Blair has a lot of explaining to do - but will Javier give him the chance?
Olive tries to drum up support for her safari party. Dieter and Trish plan a trip. Stanley can't take Rosemary's rehearsals seriously.
Olive's plan is not popular. Trish and Dieter depart for a make or break holiday.
Rosario confuses professional concern for loving affection.
Freddie meets a visitor called Joanne who believes her daughter has been kidnapped. Isabelle wants Stephen to leave his wife, but he's not sure. Terry is confronted about Joy's attack.

The final episode of the controversial saga of life in Los Barcos comes almost exactly one year after it began. Eldorado had its first outing on 6 July 1992 and met with critical derision. Improved viewing figures and growing cult status could not save it but in its final weeks, however, the series has created a large number of sensational plotlines.
